titulo: Ukraine fired 400 drones toward Moscow, city's mayor says
cuerpo: Ukraine fired more than 400 drones toward Moscow in its latest major attack on the Russian capital, the city's mayor said Monday. The same day, Ukrainian officials said a Russian missile strike on a ‌ship carrying corn near Ukraine's southern port of Odesa killed 10 people in the deadliest attack in a weeks-long flare-up of violence in the Black Sea.
